==Adding new fonts==

Font files are provided in an array because JavaScript cannot include files other than Javascript files.

If you want to add a font, you need to convert the file to a data URL and add it to the fonts in fonts.js or add it as Javascript cell.

The following code allows you to convert a file to a data URL.

Click on Run. An Open link lets you select a file which you can convert into a Data URL.
